subject.title: fix(feishu): use union_id as fallback for @mention detection in multi-bot groups

question: Which Feishu bot identity strategy should this PR use before any repair or merge attempt continues?
rationale: The branch is paused for human review, the proposed union_id source is disputed, and choosing the permanent identity source affects message delivery semantics for existing multi-bot Feishu groups.

options.title: Rewrite with proven identity
